Question 1
?

Which of the following gives the unit tangent vector to the curve r(t)=⟨2t,4sin⁡2t,4cos⁡2t⟩ at an arbitrary point where t∈(−∞,∞)?

a
 117⟨1,4cos⁡2t,−4sin⁡2t⟩
b
 117⟨t2,2cos⁡2t,−2sin⁡2t⟩
c
 217⟨t,2cos⁡2t,−2sin⁡2t⟩
d
 117⟨1,4cos⁡2t,−4sin⁡2t⟩
e
 117⟨t,cos⁡2t,−sin⁡2t⟩
